label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the insecure randomness is used to generate a session ID/remember-me token which is stored in a cookie and later used for authentication. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the user-provided value from the cookie is directly concatenated into the HTML response without proper encoding, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths, leading to case TP.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source (new java.util.Random().nextFloat()) used to create rememberMeKey
User-provided value from cookie directly concatenated into HTML response without encoding
